description: Land Acquisition - Lands in Kakkele, Weragoda, Midellawala and Pallewela, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District, acquire for the Central Expressway
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents of multiple land parcels across different villages. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
